verdict: Partial compliance. English caption and wide framing succeeded; screen-locked typography, static UI, pure axial motion, and requested hold periods did not fully succeed.

checks.english_caption: CORE SYSTEMS / BUILT IN-HOUSE remains correctly spelled and legible in sampled frames.
checks.screen_locked_caption: Fail: measured headline left bound moves from x69 to x43, a 26px leftward shift. Approximate headline bounds also expand from 460x107 to 467x110.
checks.tablet_framing: All corners and full screen remain visible in sampled source frames and actual Chrome video at matching 937.5x400 display size; measured minimum caption-device gap remains about 32 source pixels.
checks.camera_movement: Approximate dark-bezel width grows from 697px to 769px, (769/697-1)*100 = 10.33 percent across the full clip. Changing background alignment and device perspective differ from pure axial push-in.
checks.hold_timing: Fail: width already grows 697 to 703px during 0-0.5s, and continues 753 to 769px during 4.5-6s.
checks.four_second_edit_window: 0.5-4.5s gives 4.0 seconds; approximate width grows 703 to 753px, (753/703-1)*100 = 7.11 percent. Device and headline remain separate. This does not cure title drift or changing UI details.
checks.ui_preservation: Three main characters and seven game cards retained. Faces, hair, clothing contours and fine UI details change across frames, so unchanged static screen content fails.
checks.ratio: Wide 7:3 retained; not exact source 1918:820. Relative difference about 0.2433 percent. No observed device crop at page display ratio.
checks.no_cuts_or_new_text: No scene cuts, title duplication or additional English wording observed in sampled frames.

verification: Read-only ffprobe and complete 145-frame ffmpeg decode; all-frame threshold position tracking; 11 source frames visually reviewed, including exact 0,0.5,4.5,6s; independent second visual reviewer; actual MP4 decoded in Chrome at 937.5x400 CSS object-fit:cover.
limitations: Bounds are approximate dark-pixel silhouettes, not exact hardware segmentation. Fine UI text is too small for a claim of exact preservation. Visual inspection used sampled frames, not continuous viewing of every frame.
changes: Only QA scripts, extracted frames and reports were added in this review directory. Source video, generated start image, prompt and website unchanged. No trim or caption edit performed.
